styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, music venues and the Victorian city.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Curry Mile, Northern Quarter cafés and markets.

styles.label: Nightlife
styles.blurb: Pubs, gigs and clubs in the Northern Quarter.

stays.why: Next to the main train station and tram stops; easiest base for a short first visit.
Independent bars, cafés and record shops on your doorstep; walkable to the centre.
Central and close to the canal, museums and big shopping streets.
Quiet former mill district with good food and drink; about 15 minutes' walk to Piccadilly.

food: Try a proper Northern Sunday roast or a pie in a traditional pub; prices vary, so check the menu.
Curry Mile on Wilmslow Road is the classic spot for South Asian food; many places are cheap and casual.
The Northern Quarter has the densest cluster of independent cafés and brunch spots.
Look for food halls and markets for a mix of stalls at mid-range prices; check opening days on the day.
Book popular restaurants ahead for Friday and Saturday nights, especially in Ancoats and the Northern Quarter.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a tram or train trip out to a nearby town or the countryside; check times on the day.
Football fans can add a stadium tour; book ahead as slots sell out.
Add a live music night at a smaller venue instead of a second museum.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the museums, the Northern Quarter and a good meal or gig, with time for a rainy afternoon indoors.

month_notes: Jan: cold and wet, highs near 7°C. Pack a warm waterproof coat.
Feb: still cold, highs around 8°C, with about 16 rain days.
Mar: slowly milder, highs near 10°C; keep the rain jacket.
Apr: brighter, highs around 13°C and fewer rain days.
May: pleasant, highs near 16°C; good for walking the centre.
Jun: mild and long days, highs around 19°C, but expect showers.
Jul: warmest month, highs near 20°C, and the wettest by rain days.
Aug: similar to July, highs around 20°C; carry an umbrella.
Sep: still mild at 18°C; a good shoulder month.
Oct: cooler at 14°C and wetter again; layers help.
Nov: cold and damp, highs near 10°C, about 17 rain days.
Dec: cold at 8°C with the most rain days; pack waterproofs.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate and often wet: mild summers, cool winters, and rain possible in any month.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect 12–19 rain days every month. A waterproof jacket beats an umbrella in the wind.

items.title: Mild summers
items.text: July and August peak near 20°C with lows around 12°C. Rarely hot.

items.title: Cool winters
items.text: January and February highs near 7–8°C and lows around 2°C. Bring a warm coat.

items.title: Best odds: April to June
items.text: April has the fewest rain days and May–June are mild and bright.

items.title: Wettest: July and December
items.text: July has about 19 rain days and December about 18. Plan indoor backups.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof shell and comfortable shoes for wet pavements.

transit.best: Walk the compact centre; use the Metrolink tram for anything further.

modes.text: Metrolink tram is quick and covers the centre and suburbs. Zone 1 is free with some train tickets.
Bee Network buses are yellow and franchised; single fares are around £2.
Taxis are metered. Uber, Bolt and local apps all work in the city.
Driving in the centre is slow and parking is costly. Use park and ride instead.
The centre is compact and walkable. Starling Bikes offers bike share with e-bikes.
No ferry in the city. The nearest cruise terminal is Liverpool.
